note: By-eye relevance over the top-10 pool returned by the baseline. 1 = the image clearly matches the query's main attribute, 0 = it does not (including ambiguous cases, which are deliberately scored 0 so the number is a lower bound). Pool currently covers baseline top-10 only; extend a query's dict when a new method surfaces unseen ids.
rule: Judge the dominant visible colour / the shoe type. Same-hue near neighbours count (charcoal->black, tan/beige->brown, navy->blue, maroon->red); a clearly different hue or a dominant colour that is not the queried one counts 0. Small accents (stripes, logos, soles) are ignored.
